description: This source file defines the DelegatingAuthenticationService class, which implements an authentication service that delegates authentication requests to a remote identity server. It includes configuration setup, DNS health checks, and methods for verifying external and plain authentication.

classes.name: DelegatingAuthenticationService
classes.description: A service that delegates authentication requests to a remote identity server, with health check registration, configuration, and verification methods.

methods.name: setConfig
methods.description: Sets specific configuration properties for the authentication service.

methods.name: setDnsClient
methods.description: Sets the DNS client used for checking authentication service availability via DNS resolution.

methods.name: setConnectionFactory
methods.description: Sets the connection factory for connecting to the authentication server.

methods.name: registerLivenessChecks
methods.description: Registers health checks related to service liveness; intentionally does not register any here.

methods.name: registerReadinessChecks
methods.description: Registers health checks to verify the accessibility of the authentication service via DNS or Address Resolver.

methods.name: doStart
methods.description: Starts the service by initializing the AuthenticationServerClient.

methods.name: verifyExternal
methods.description: Performs external verification of a user by delegating to the client.

methods.name: verifyPlain
methods.description: Performs plain text verification of credentials.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Provides a string representation of the service, including host and port configuration.
